answer: Stake posts to escrow at submission and clears only at finality. Three peers spot-check each answer; a mismatch forfeits the stake outright. Duplicates die on replay, not on name: the same payload resubmitted under a fresh identity is an echo that returns an identical hash, and the second claim pays zero. At each epoch summit the escrow settles and a vault of forfeited stakes funds the honest jurors. One fake costs a full stake plus a failed replay, so farming stops paying.
